posts.body:
Images in Rpg maker 2003
I'm having trouble showing images.
The first is their size, even if I use a base from an RTP picture, I can't reduce or increase it in size.
I managed to use an image of a "monster" in the show images command, but I was unable to increase the aspect ratio of the image, originally it was 60x80 and I wanted to place a 160x160 image.
The second is the color indexes, which maybe if I know or can export to create an image I think I could correct their size.
For now I found the image of the Bahamut moster (175X160) which has similar measurements, but the question still persists.
How should I do to be able to create images like huds, for example, and display them in the show images command?

posts.body:
